name: Beavercreek
takeaway: Beavercreek's city aggregation is on Constellation at 8.699¢/kWh through December 2026 (city page, Energy Alliances consultant). The next term is not confirmed.
hook: Beavercreek's city electric deal runs out in December. Do you know what your accounts roll to after that?
notes: AES Ohio (Dayton Power & Light) territory. Greene County. Major retail (Fairfield Commons) and commercial/professional presence along I-675 and Route 35 corridors. City aggregation page lists Constellation, 8.699¢/kWh, August 2025–December 2026. Open question: was the Res. 26-36 contract executed, and at what rate from December 2026.

name: Huber Heights
takeaway: AES Ohio standard offer is about 10.86¢/kWh for June 2026–May 2027, about 15% above the prior year's energy rate. Whether the city has an aggregation is unresolved.
hook: AES raised its standard supply rate about 15% in June. Are your accounts on a supplier contract or on the AES default?

name: Springfield
takeaway: Springfield in Clark County is a NOPEC electric member on the community map, the 2026 annual report, and the city's NOPEC resources page. The file price is the Ohio Edison standard, 10.399¢/kWh variable, from the September 2026 meter read through the June 2027 meter read, no exit fee. The city resources page does not restate that price.
